office.m365.title: Microsoft 365
office.m365.help: Open and edit files of the media library in Microsoft 365 for the web (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Requires membership in Microsoft's Cloud Storage Partner Program (CSPP); Microsoft allows the address of the wiki. Users without the right to download see files in the browser only because Microsoft cannot reliably block downloads.
office.m365.url_help: Leave empty for production (https://onenote.officeapps.live.com/hosting/discovery); for tests the address from the CSPP program.
office.m365.verify_proof: Verify the signature of every request (proof key, recommended)
office.m365.verify_proof_help: The wiki only accepts requests signed by the office server.
office.m365.test_ok: Connected: {view} file types to view, {edit} to edit
office.m365.proof_missing: The server publishes no proof key: switch the check off or update the server.
office.m365.default_hint: Choose the program as default viewer in the general settings (media).
office.m365.enabled_help: The wiki only contacts Microsoft servers when this is switched on.
